# Mashed meat

Type: Food | Internal ID: MashedMeat | Source: Cauldron | Usage: Eating | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Asksvin tail x1, Volture meat x1, Fiddlehead x1 | Max Health: 100 | Max Stamina: 34 | Duration: 25m | Healing: 6 hp/tick

# Introduction

Mashed meat is an Ashlands-tier food.

## Recipe

Mashed meat is produced in a level 6 Cauldron with:
• 1 Asksvin tail
• 1 Volture meat
• 1 Fiddlehead

## Notes

• Mashed meat provides the second highest health gain in the game at 100, only being surpassed by Piquant pie.
